description: Reads the places, people and records of a business template: "list" sites, resources or staff; "agenda" every service's sessions with who booked (62 days at most); "accounts" sessions, minutes and people per professional, site and resource (default this month); "notes"; "closures" from now on; a client's "userBookings", "userNotes" (private) and "userRating"; "applications" of businesses asking to join; "reviews"; "sellers" and "sellerStatus". Changes nothing; neblla_business writes. More: neblla_get_llms tools/business_read

action.description: What to read. By action: list {kind}; accounts {from?, to?}; agenda {from, to}; notes {from?, to?, who?}; closures {from?, to?}; applications {status?}; reviews {kind?, id?, hidden?}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

from.description: accounts / agenda / notes / closures: earliest date.

hidden.description: reviews: only the hidden (true) or the shown (false).

id.description: reviews: only this site or user.

kind.description: list: sites, resources or staff; reviews: sites (default) or users.

status.description: applications: pending (default), approved, rejected or all.

to.description: accounts / agenda / notes / closures: latest date.

user.description: userBookings / userNotes / userRating: the user's id in the app.

who.description: notes: only about this one ("staff:<id>", "site:<id>" or a name).

name: neblla_business_read
title: Read the business
